summary: refactor(content-server): rename beta-settings and share serveSettingsPage
description:
Because:

* Three places repeated the proxy_settings choice for the Settings page
* Two flags described one thing: which error page to render

This commit:

* Renames beta-settings to settings and swapBetaMeta to injectServerConfig
* Adds serveSettingsPage and uses it in the 404 and 500 handlers
* Replaces serverError and notFound with one errorPage field

Closes FXA-14884
